Emma: Creston procurement asked for a single-page SLO insert they can drop into contracts. Need uptime, p99 latency, and a worked credits example.
Priya (Creston): Legal review Mon. p99 they'd accept <= 500ms, target SLA 99.9%.
Noah: Recommend showing 30d rolling uptime + p50/p95/p99. For credits show canonical hosted formula and a tiny worked example.
Emma: Canonical hosted formula we use: credit = max(0, ((SLA - achieved) / SLA) * committed_amount) capped per contract.
Noah: Worked example to paste: sla=0.999, achieved=0.996, commitment=25000 -> credit = ((0.999-0.996)/0.999)*25000 ≈ $75. Code snippet: ```sla=0.999
achieved=0.996
commitment=25000
credit=max(0,(sla-achieved)/sla*commitment)```
SLO-bot: Auto snapshot: crst-221 30d uptime=99.81%, p99=430ms. Dashboard: https://console.redwood.ai/customers/crst-221/slo :information_source:
Priya (Creston): Please add a two-sentence fallback note about routing to compatible model variants and potential minor latency/quality changes. Procurement wants transparency.
Emma: Will draft one-pager with snapshot, worked calc, and a short fallback blurb. ETA: Thurs EOD. Noah will review then we send to Priya.
Priya (Creston): Ack, thanks!
